item.title: PRISM 0.3.8
item.description:
Version 0.3.8

What's new in PRISM

Connected local study

  • Turn a PDF highlight or page note into editable Knowledge with a link back to its exact page and annotation.
  • Create linked practice questions and manual review cards from a note, then start a focused review of its due cards.

An exam plan that adapts

  • Plan multiple review rounds before your exam using your existing FSRS schedule, chapter scope and daily time budget.
  • Refresh the plan after real review ratings or practice attempts, while preserving fixed items and completed work.
  • See today's exam work on the Dashboard. Future rounds are estimates assuming Good; they do not create review records.

Your week in research

  • Save a local research recap on Friday evening, or catch up the next time you open PRISM.
  • See new recaps on the Dashboard, revisit saved weeks and open their original research records.
  • Confirm a suggested next step before it becomes a task.

Faster formulas

  • Type $ to insert a matching pair with the cursor inside. Wrap selected text, skip an existing closing delimiter, or remove an empty pair with Backspace.

Your notes, PDF attachments, annotations, links, review progress and settings stay in your workspace. Automatic installation remains off unless you enable it. This release does not enable cloud sync, hosted accounts, payments or cloud AI.
